name: 1991 eruption of Mount Pinatubo
short_desc: A major eruption in the Philippines sends ash and sulfur dioxide into the atmosphere and temporarily cools the climate.
date_note: 2 April to 2 September 1991, with the climactic eruption on 15 June. These dates describe the eruptive episode, not the full duration of its climatic effects.
notes: New source-linked entry. The Wikipedia introduction, date evidence and article identity received an initial editorial check; independent claim-specific source review remains open.
